# Hack Sketch

> Hack Sketch makes short animated videos that explain simple DIY tricks and everyday life hacks in under 30 seconds.

- [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@hacksketch)
- [All hacks](https://hacksketchyt.github.io/hacks/)

## Hacks

- [Squeaky Door? This Simple Oil Trick Often Silences It](https://hacksketchyt.github.io/hacks/squeaky-door-this-simple-oil-trick-often-silences-it.html): A squeaky hinge often just needs a few drops of household oil.
- [Unclog a Slow Drain Without Harsh Chemicals? Try This Fizz Hack](https://hacksketchyt.github.io/hacks/unclog-a-slow-drain-without-harsh-chemicals-try-this-fizz-ha.html): Clear a slow drain with baking soda, vinegar and hot tap water.
- [Phone Dying by Lunch? 3 Settings That Help It Last Longer](https://hacksketchyt.github.io/hacks/phone-dying-by-lunch-3-settings-that-help-it-last-longer.html): Try auto-brightness (Android: Adaptive brightness; iPhone: Accessibility → Display & Text Size), a 30-second timeout (iPhone: Display & Brightness → Auto-Lock) and battery saver (iPhone: Low Power Mode). Menus vary.
- [Rock-Hard Brown Sugar? Soften It With a Slice of Bread](https://hacksketchyt.github.io/hacks/rock-hard-brown-sugar-soften-it-with-a-slice-of-bread.html): Rock-hard brown sugar? Seal it with a slice of fresh bread for about a day.
- [Is Your Egg Still Fresh? The 10-Second Water Test](https://hacksketchyt.github.io/hacks/is-your-egg-still-fresh-the-10-second-water-test.html): To check if an egg is fresh, put it in a bowl of cold water. Fresh eggs sink and lie flat; older eggs stand up; if it floats, throw it out. #shorts #eggs #kitchenhacks
